image.description: Portrait image for avatar. PNG/JPG/JPEG/WebP, max 20MB, max 10000px.
image.title: Image

audio.description: Audio file for avatar speech. MP3/WAV/M4A/AAC, max 30s. Provide either audio or tts_text.
audio.title: Audio

tts_text.description: Text for TTS avatar speech (30-200 chars). Provide either tts_text or audio.
tts_text.title: Tts Text

tts_speaker_id.description: TTS voice ID. Use 'auto' for automatic selection. Required when using tts_text.
tts_speaker_id.title: Tts Speaker Id

prompt.description: Visual guidance for avatar movements, pose, and expressions
prompt.title: Prompt
